task.title: Earth ground and power
task.shortdesc: Earth grounding and power provides protection from electrostatic discharge or other forms of EMI.

taskbody.prereq: A nearby earth grounding point is available.

context.note: Before making power terminations, de-energize the 24V power source. Do not restore power until completing all other mounting and wiring. Refer to “Power up and initial checkout” for more details.

stentry.p: 2.1 (AC): Dedicated 24V transformer required, with neither side of the transformer secondary tied to ground or
2.2 (DC): Polarity is unimportant (uses onboard diode bridge), with neither leg tied to ground or
2.3 (Wall-mount AC adapter, ) instead of wiring 24V to two-position connector

step.cmd: Install the included earth ground wire to the controller’s earth ground spade lug and terminate the other end to a nearby earth ground.
Unplug the controller’s two-position power connector plug and terminate the 24V supply source (AC or DC) to the connector. Leave the connector unplugged for now.
